messages:
morgan: heads up — staging push to eu-ecr just got quarantined by deploy-bot. push reported a partial layer fingerprint mismatch; provenance shows the layer split across two upload shards (chunk index conflict).
raj: ack. which image/tag?
morgan: service-payments:staging-2026-03-20-48 (digest available). deploy-bot log: `provenance: fingerprint_mismatch: shard[0] != shard[1]`
deploy-bot: Automated hold applied to image service-payments:staging-2026-03-20-48. Reason: partial layer fingerprint split (chunk index conflict). Suggested actions: retag-from-prev | republish-single-chunk | escalate-kms.
sasha: :eyes: Do we have a backup digest to pin to?
olivia: previous digest is sha256:9f3b...a7c1 from canary-41, good for rollback if needed.
raj: my vote is pinback to the previous digest for the change window (we can't risk consumer-facing canaries). Morgan — can you confirm CI artifacts for 9f3b...a7c1 still exist?
morgan: CI artifacts exist. quick check: `gsutil ls gs://builds/service-payments/9f3b*/layers/**` returns all 5 layers.
olivia: if we pin, we should also publish a short release note and toggle the canary fallback for eu region.
morgan: agreed. two small caveats: pinback will interrupt the staging promotion pipeline for ~10m and will cancel the in-flight deployment. any objections?
raj: no objections, do it.
sasha: before pinning can we attempt a republish with consolidated chunking? if it's quick it'd avoid rollback. `repack --consolidate` on the builder image might succeed.
morgan: tried repack locally, failure persists (same shard split). suspect transient registry multipart re-assembly bug in eu-ecr.
canary-bot: Canary metrics: staging eu requests spike +0.2% error rate in the last 2m — still within tolerances but trending.
raj: ok proceed with pinback. morgan — please run deploybot pinback flow and update the release notes. include COSIGN metadata and note quarantined push in changelog.
morgan: running: `deploybot pinback --image service-payments --from-digest sha256:9f3b...a7c1 --reason "quarantined shard split in eu-ecr"`. Will post when done. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Pinback started. Will cancel in-flight staging promotion and repoint tag staging -> sha256:9f3b...a7c1. Audit entry created.
morgan: pinback completed. staging tag now points to 9f3b...a7c1. Release note draft pushed to /docs/releases/staging-notes.md with brief entry about quarantined publish and mitigation plan.
olivia: thanks — can we add follow-up task to eng-infra backlog to run a replicated multipart upload test against eu-ecr mirror?
raj: yes add ticket and assign to eng-infra. I'll follow up with AWS rep to see if there's regional multipart reassembly issues.
sasha: noted. postmortem only if we see recurrence. for now marking this resolved.
morgan: closing thread after 10m observation window, will reopen if deploy-bot flags anything else.
